label: FoxSubject
description: Looks for danger and keeps a list of observers. When it finds danger, it publishes the discovery through the Observer interface.

fields.label: observers: Observer[]
fields.description: The list of observers that receive the subject’s notifications.

methods.label: attach(o: Observer)
methods.description: Subscribe an observer by adding it to the observers field.

methods.label: detach(o: Observer)
methods.description: Unsubscribe an observer by removing it from the observers field.

methods.label: notify()
methods.description: Publish the current discovery by calling update(discovery) on each attached observer.

methods.label: discoverDanger() · subject logic
methods.description: When the fox finds danger, save what it sees and call notify(). Publish nothing when the path is safe.

label: Observer
description: The shared update(discovery) contract. Every concrete observer implements it to receive notifications.

methods.label: update(discovery) · contract
methods.description: Put this method in the Observer interface. Each concrete observer implements it.

label: NarionObserver
description: Implements Observer. Gets the discovery and helps Narion plan a safer path.

methods.label: update(discovery) · NarionObserver
methods.description: Get the notification and call planRoute() for Narion.

methods.label: planRoute() · business logic
methods.description: Narion uses the message to choose a safer path.

label: DreKaarObserver
description: Implements Observer. Gets the same discovery and helps Dre’Kaar protect the group.

methods.label: update(discovery) · DreKaarObserver
methods.description: Get the notification and call prepareDefense() for Dre’Kaar.

methods.label: prepareDefense() · business logic
methods.description: Dre’Kaar gets ready to protect the group.
